headline: Revenue surges, margins expand on strong storage demand
summary_short: Western Digital's fiscal fourth quarter (period ended July 3, 2026) revenue rose 44% y/y to $3.75 billion as GAAP gross margin expanded to 54.1% and diluted EPS climbed to $8.21 from $0.67 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue of $3.75B (+44% y/y, +12% q/q) drove GAAP operating income to $1.56B (+130% y/y) as gross margin expanded to 54.1% (+1,310bps y/y) and operating margin to 41.7% (+1,560bps y/y). Diluted EPS was $8.21 GAAP / $3.56 non-GAAP. Operating cash flow was $1.39B and free cash flow $1.28B. The company repurchased $672M of stock and paid a $0.15/share dividend. For Q1FY27 it guided non-GAAP revenue to ~$4.1B (+/-$100M), non-GAAP gross margin to 55-56%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS to $4.00 (+/-$0.15).
